# Global and user variables

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run C# code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-csharp-step.png)

## GetGlobalVar

Reads a global variable (one shared by all actions). The type you ask for, like int, is what you get. Pass false to read a temporary (not saved) one.

```csharp
T? GetGlobalVar<T>(string varName, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** The value, or the empty default (like 0) when it is missing or was stored the other way (saved vs temporary).

**Example**

```csharp
int deaths = CPH.GetGlobalVar<int>("deaths");
CPH.LogInfo($"Deaths so far: {deaths}");
```

## SetGlobalVar

Stores a global variable that every action can read. Saved means it is kept when Cuebot restarts. Pass false at the end to keep it only until Cuebot restarts.

```csharp
void SetGlobalVar(string varName, object? value, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SetGlobalVar("deaths", 5);
```

## UnsetGlobalVar

Deletes a global variable. Pass false to delete a temporary (not saved) one; it only deletes the one stored that way.

```csharp
void UnsetGlobalVar(string varName, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.UnsetGlobalVar("deaths");
```

## GetGlobalVarValues

Gives you a list of all saved global variables, each with its name, value and last change. Pass false to list the temporary ones instead.

```csharp
List<GlobalVariableValue> GetGlobalVarValues(bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** A list of global variables.

**Example**

```csharp
var globals = CPH.GetGlobalVarValues();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {globals.Count} saved globals.");
```

## ClearNonPersistedGlobals

Deletes every temporary (not saved) global variable at once. Saved ones stay.

```csharp
void ClearNonPersistedGlobals()
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ClearNonPersistedGlobals();
```

## GetTwitchUserVar

Reads a Twitch viewer's variable, by their login name. The type you ask for (like int) is what you get. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.

```csharp
T? GetTwitchUserVar<T>(string userLogin, string varName, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** The value, or the empty default (like 0 or empty) when the viewer or variable is not found.

**Example**

```csharp
int points = CPH.GetTwitchUserVar<int>("coolviewer", "points");
CPH.LogInfo($"Points: {points}");
```

## GetTwitchUserVarById

Reads a Twitch viewer's variable, by their user id. The type you ask for (like int) is what you get. Cuebot ignores the saved true/false here.

```csharp
T? GetTwitchUserVarById<T>(string userId, string varName, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** The value, or the empty default (like 0 or empty) when the viewer or variable is not found.

**Example**

```csharp
int points = CPH.GetTwitchUserVarById<int>("12345678", "points");
CPH.LogInfo($"Points: {points}");
```

## SetTwitchUserVar

Stores a variable for one Twitch viewer, by their login name. Pass false at the end to keep it only until Cuebot restarts.

```csharp

```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp

```

## GetTwitchUsersVar

Gives you a list of every Twitch viewer who has this variable, with their id, name, value and last change. Pass false to list the ones not saved instead.

```csharp
List<UserVariableValue<T>> GetTwitchUsersVar<T>(string varName, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** A list of viewers and their values (empty when nobody has it).

**Example**

```csharp
var all = CPH.GetTwitchUsersVar<int>("points");
CPH.LogInfo($"{all.Count} viewers have points.");
```
